name: 千人千面生成器 OpenElf
description: Generate character sets in batches by layer and part combinations: adjust rarity weights, preview, batch-generate up to 100 items, and download the pack.
description_zh: 按图层与配件组合批量生成形象作品：调整稀有度权重、预览、单次最多 100 件、打包下载。
description_en: Batch-generate characters from layer and part combinations: tune rarity weights, preview, generate up to 100 items at once, and download them as a pack.
examples_zh: 帮我看下可用的图层和配件目录
把背景槽位的稀有度权重调成 30
批量生成 50 个像素风角色并打包下载
examples_en: Show me the available layers and parts
Set the background slot rarity weight to 30
Batch-generate 50 pixel-art characters and download the pack
